_comment: Ready-made dashboards for the bundled datasets. Each one: a flat 'fact' query (one row per event), KPI cards, slicers and charts that aggregate that fact table. agg = sum | mean | count | nunique | max | min | mean_pct. Any other database gets an automatic or AI-designed dashboard with the same structure.

chinook.title: Music store sales
chinook.fact_sql: SELECT il.InvoiceLineId AS line_id, i.InvoiceId AS invoice_id, date(i.InvoiceDate) AS invoice_date, i.BillingCountry AS country, i.BillingCity AS city, c.CustomerId AS customer_id, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS sales_rep, g.Name AS genre, m.Name AS media_type, ar.Name AS artist, al.Title AS album, t.Name AS track, il.Quantity AS quantity, il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Invoice i ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN Employee e ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId LEFT JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId LEFT JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId

northwind.title: Trading company sales
northwind.fact_sql: SELECT od.OrderID AS order_id, date(o.OrderDate) AS order_date, COALESCE(c.CompanyName, o.CustomerID) AS customer, COALESCE(c.Country, o.ShipCountry) AS customer_country, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, s.CompanyName AS shipper, cat.CategoryName AS category, p.ProductName AS product, sup.CompanyName AS supplier, od.Quantity AS quantity, od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount) AS revenue FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Orders o ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID LEFT JOIN Customers c ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID LEFT JOIN Employees e ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID LEFT JOIN Shippers s ON s.ShipperID = o.ShipVia JOIN Products p ON p.ProductID = od.ProductID LEFT JOIN Categories cat ON cat.CategoryID = p.CategoryID LEFT JOIN Suppliers sup ON sup.SupplierID = p.SupplierID

sakila.title: DVD rental revenue
sakila.fact_sql: SELECT p.payment_id, date(p.payment_date) AS payment_date, p.amount AS revenue, 'Store ' || s.store_id AS store, cu.customer_id, cu.first_name || ' ' || cu.last_name AS customer, co.country, cat.name AS category, f.title AS film, f.rating, r.rental_id FROM payment p JOIN staff s ON s.staff_id = p.staff_id JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_id = p.customer_id JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN country co ON co.country_id = ci.country_id LEFT JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id LEFT JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id LEFT JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id LEFT JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = f.film_id LEFT JOIN category cat ON cat.category_id = fc.category_id

titanic.title: Titanic passenger survival
titanic.fact_sql: SELECT passengerid AS passenger_id, CASE pclass WHEN 1 THEN '1st class' WHEN 2 THEN '2nd class' ELSE '3rd class' END AS class, sex, age, CASE WHEN age IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN age < 13 THEN 'Child (0-12)' WHEN age < 18 THEN 'Teen (13-17)' WHEN age < 35 THEN 'Young adult (18-34)' WHEN age < 60 THEN 'Adult (35-59)' ELSE 'Senior (60+)' END AS age_group, fare, CASE embarked WHEN 'S' THEN 'Southampton' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cherbourg' WHEN 'Q' THEN 'Queenstown' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS port, survived, CASE survived WHEN 1 THEN 'Survived' ELSE 'Died' END AS outcome, sibsp + parch AS family_size FROM passengers

covid_latest.title: COVID-19 by country
covid_latest.fact_sql: SELECT location AS country, continent, population, total_cases, total_deaths, total_cases_per_million, total_deaths_per_million, people_fully_vaccinated_per_hundred, gdp_per_capita, life_expectancy FROM covid_latest WHERE continent IS NOT NULL

tips.title: Restaurant tips
tips.fact_sql: SELECT rowid AS bill_id, total_bill, tip, ROUND(tip * 100.0 / total_bill, 2) AS tip_pct, sex, smoker, day, time, size FROM tips
